project.name: M3JDK :: Compiler Mat Sortable Processor
project.description: jdk.m3.compiler.matsortable (module org.m3jdk.compiler.matsortable): M3MatSortableProcessor, the opt-in JSR-269 annotation processor of the mat sortables (jdk.m3.collections.M3Sortable, M3SortField, M3SortSignal, M3SortDistance, M3SortDependency, located by canonical name) that writes one deterministic source companion per annotated class or record: schema and order-policy SHA-256 seals, structural declaration facts, compareExact over the declared columns or the primitive signal, exactComparator, primary / signals, the validated domain distance and the ComparisonEvidence receipt. Never mutates the annotated type; java.compiler is a static, compile-time-only module dependency and nothing of m3-collections is needed at compile time. Pure Java 21. Relocated by recipe (recipe/mat-sortable-processor-20261107/relocate.py, RELOCATION_MAP.tsv, PROVENANCE.tsv) from the donor hsoliwal/com.synexia develop 56cbdc631259; the donor's javac contract and the processor oracle run in the test phase against the relocated annotations of m3-collections (test scope).
